frequency_question: How often do called indefinite strikes by major bank union coalitions actually materialize into a full walkout within the target window rather than being deferred or settled?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide indefinite strike notices issued by multi-union coalitions representing bank employees. Excludes single-bank strikes, brief one-day symbolic strikes, or strikes outside the financial sector.

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association (AIBEA) / UFBU Escalation

coverage_note: 4 named major strike threat cycles by the specific coalition in question; historical tendency heavily favors last-minute conciliation.
known_gaps: Excludes minor regional bank strikes that did not involve the unified national forum.
skeleton: Four major escalation cycles resulting in strike notices by the UFBU over the last decade, out of which most were averted at the final hour through conciliation, with only minority instances proceeding to full execution within the window.
multiplier: 1 hit out of 4 documented major threat cycles
validity_reason: Labor relations frameworks and conciliation mechanisms in the banking sector remain stable over multi-year periods.
